array.string: set -e # PATHS: adjust for your machine NODE_BIN="/opt/homebrew/bin/node" SWEEP_BIN="/path/to/teamdynamix-mcp/dist/sweep.js" LOG_DIR="$HOME/.local/state/tdx-watch" TRIAGE_PROMPT="/path/to/teamdynamix-mcp/scripts/triage-prompt.md" mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR" OUT=$("$NODE_BIN" "$SWEEP_BIN") || { echo "$OUT" >> "$LOG_DIR/sweep.log"; exit 1; } echo "$OUT" >> "$LOG_DIR/sweep.log" PENDING=$(echo "$OUT" | /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("pendingCount", 0))') if [ "$PENDING" -gt 0 ]; then # Harness-side triage: headless agent run, read-only toward TDX. opencode run --file "$TRIAGE_PROMPT" >> "$LOG_DIR/triage.log" 2>&1 fi
